# Security

- SEC-015 (must): Cryptography and deserialization follow these rules: don't write your own; protect data with ASP.NET Core Data Protection, or encrypt with an authenticated cipher (AesGcm or ChaCha20Poly1305); compare secrets with CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals; derive keys from passwords with PBKDF2 over SHA-256 or better and a high iteration count; draw secrets from RandomNumberGenerator; and treat everything deserialized from outside the app as untrusted input.
- SEC-025 (must): Prefer these algorithms by application: Aes for data privacy; HMACSHA256 or HMACSHA512 for data integrity; ECDsa or RSA for digital signatures; RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes or RandomNumberGenerator.Fill for random number generation; and Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2 for generating a key from a password. To use padded CBC block ciphers safely, you must combine them with an HMAC or other data integrity check that you validate with a constant time comparison before decrypting. User input should be treated with the same precautions as malicious code calling your code with strange parameters.
